construction: Filter the saved 525 Sidon two-pair witnesses by off-diagonal endpoints; copy support masks. Refine the saved B2[2] DAG, reuse any old node/coefficients, append only genuinely new nodes. Traverse only the new family in exclude-before-include order, retaining every mask and prefix count.
new_score: For each new-family row save min over N=4..19 of |A intersect [1,N]|^2/N, reduced exactly, and every minimizing N. This finite minimum is neither an asymptotic density nor the original g(N) question.
reader: After complete result checkpoint, freeze a driver for required/forbidden, inclusive size, prefix lower quota and rational score filters; counts, maxima of finite score, rank/select, all optimum exports and explicit copied obstruction witnesses. Reader consumes saved rows without recomputing prefix counts or scores.
protected: No old pair sums, old three-pair/two-pair support constructions, base coefficients, Sidon family, old examples or accepted queries are rerun.

source.independent: Charles Helou, Characterization of Representation Functions, INTEGERS17(2017)A44, https://math.colgate.edu/~integers/r44/r44.pdf; first-page indexed definition only.
